data.text: Friction: refreshing AGENTS.md and CLAUDE.md for a release means running init, and init now also creates .claude/settings.json with both hooks when there is none. In this repository that file is gitignored and the session hook lives elsewhere, so the refresh quietly installed a second, PATH-bound prime and prompt hook. The release step wants init --no-hooks; DOC-64 §5 should say so, or the instruction refresh should be its own command.
